spoken_script: OpenAI Claims Breakthrough on Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem. OpenAI has published a paper and Lean formalization claiming an internal AI system has generated a proof for the finite-time singularity of 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes equations. Why it matters: The Navier–Stokes problem is one of the seven Millennium Prize problems; a verified solution would represent a major milestone in both computational mathematics and AI-driven scientific discovery.
